notes: Exhaustive check, no genuine Bestsellers-type PLP found on hoeffner.de. Checked: (1) full mega-menu on homepage - 14 top-level nav entries (moebel, gartenuebersicht, kueche, haushalt, badezimmer, schlafzimmer, textilien, buero, lampen, accessoires, baby-kind, angebote, inspiration, kochmuetze) plus their flyout sub-menus - no Bestseller/Topseller/Meistverkauft/Beliebteste entry anywhere. (2) full footer link list (~100 links) - none match. (3) /online-shop, the site's full category-tree overview page - searched for Neuheit/Bestseller/Topseller/Meistverkauf/Beliebt (German) - zero hits. (4) site's own search at /suche?q=... for 'bestseller' and 'topseller' - both returned articleCount:0 (confirmed via the page's own JSON loader data, a genuine no-match, not a default/fallback result set: title and empty tiles array corroborate). (5) direct URL slug guesses (/bestseller, /bestseller-moebel, /topseller, /neuheiten-adjacent forms n/a here, /beliebteste-produkte, /meistverkauft) all returned HTTP 404. The only popularity-related signal found anywhere on the site is a generic cross-category SORT option labelled 'Beliebteste' (value popularProducts) available on the search-results sorting dropdown and presumably on category pages - this re-sorts an existing listing by popularity, it is not itself a distinct Bestsellers merchandising PLP, so it does not qualify per the brief's arbitrary-filter exclusion. Conclusion: hoeffner.de has no dedicated Bestsellers/Topseller/Meistverkauft listing.
